One Event Greece & Cyprus · DMC Travel Ltd

The Agency

One fusion of experts,
one standard: perfection

Founded in 2022

One Event Cyprus & Greece was founded in 2022 by a group of professionals with years of experience in the tourism and event industry. This fusion of experts is a perfect match for any kind of event worldwide.

A profound insight into the local and international corporate event business led us to pursue an efficient, flexible set-up that meets our clients’ expectations — built on a very personal approach, flexible business models and long-term partnership.

We act sustainably and prefer local suppliers. We look for the extraordinary and the unusual — so your guests don’t attend an event, they live one.

Vision

An efficient and flexible set-up that meets every expectation in corporate events.

Key values

A personal approach, flexibility in business models, long-term partnerships.

Sustainability

We act sustainably and prefer local suppliers wherever we operate.

The key team

Alexis Onoufriou

Managing Partner & CEO

“He always has that special ‘out of the box’ plan for any company, those ideas that make his events extra-ordinary and life memorable.”

Alexis is a Chartered Accountant who has diversified his field of expertise by following his passion in the Corporate Tourism Industry. For over 10 years, he was leading the execution of Corporate Events, as a Managing Partner of Liberty International Tourism Group for Greece & Cyprus. His accounting and numeric literacy combined with his long experience in the Event and Destination Management fields give Alexis a great advantage in providing tailored solutions to any need and within any budget.

Demetra Onoufriou

Managing Partner, Sales & Marketing

“Identifying niches and creating opportunities for any corporate need.”

Demetra is a Marketer who has been heading the Marketing Department of AstroBank in Cyprus, former Piraeus Bank, the leading bank in Greece. She has a track record of producing, presenting and managing innovative ideas and business solutions, with great expertise in event management. Demetra’s successful 20+ year career in Banking came to a close when she decided to join forces with her brother and take Destination & Event Management to a different level.
